title: Scholarship for Students With Refugee Status
summary: Scholarship for refugees studying full-time at state or state-recognised German higher education institutions. Candidates from all disciplines with refugee status and a maximum of 3 completed semesters can apply. Provides a monthly stipend and study allowance.

degree_levels.notes: Candidates must not yet have completed a degree recognised in Germany; not possible to apply for a postgraduate Master's programme only.

subject_areas.notes: Candidates from all disciplines and subjects are welcome to apply.

values: state or state-recognised higher education institutions in Germany
institutions.notes: Must be enrolled at a state or state-recognised higher education institution in Germany.

nationality.notes: Refugees with refugee status; specific country list provided on the page for selection.

residence.notes: Refugees who are studying at German institutions of higher education.

mandatory.text: students with a refugee status pursuing full-time courses of study
enrolment at a state or state-recognised higher education institution in Germany
at the time of application, a maximum of 3 semesters completed
evidence of German language skills of C1 level
qualified for funding as per BAföG § 8, the German Federal Training Assistance Act

preferences.text: Applicants show respect toward other religious beliefs and openness to interact with others.

funding.description: monthly stipend of up to 855 EUR plus 300 EUR allowance for study costs, individual mentoring, and additional support

application_rounds.notes: for funding beginning in the following winter semester Source deadline clock time: midnight; timezone needs confirmation.

recurring_deadline_notes: 1 October to 15 January for funding beginning in the following winter semester; 1 April to 15 July for funding beginning in the following summer semester.
